name: greynoise-mcp-server
description: MCP Server for the GreyNoise Enterprise API
long_description:
This extension provides comprehensive access to GreyNoise's threat intelligence platform, enabling Claude to analyze internet-scanning IP addresses, track threat actors, investigate vulnerabilities, and generate security insights. GreyNoise specializes in identifying and categorizing internet background noise - the automated scanning, crawling, and exploitation attempts that occur constantly across the internet.

Capabilities include:
- IP address context with Internet Scanner Intelligence (ISI) and Business Service Intelligence (BSI)
- Quick checks and bulk multi-IP analysis (up to 10,000 IPs)
- GNQL (GreyNoise Query Language) for advanced searching with full or metadata-only results
- Recall/timeseries analysis for temporal IP activity patterns
- Tag browsing, search, and activity analysis
- CVE details and trending vulnerability tracking
- Multiple analysis prompts for threat hunting, vendor assessment, and security posture

Requires a GreyNoise API key for full functionality.
